correctness.rationale: PASS. Desargues graph G(10,3)=bipartite Kneser H(5,2) is represented explicitly as the incidence/disjointness graph on two copies of the ten 2-subsets of [5]. Independently enumerated all 6,211 nonempty independent simplices and exact mod2 augmented boundary ranks (1,19,141,519,991,932,383,97,18,2), bounding rational reduced Betti dimensions by 1 in degree 4 and 5 in degree 5. Recomputed the oriented fixed-face Lefschetz trace for each of all 240 S5 x C2 symmetries; each agreed with (-1)^flip(sign(permutation)-number_fixed_points). Representation-ring positivity plus rational dimension bounds force H~4=sign(S5) tensor swap-sign and H~5=5-point permutation(S5) tensor swap-sign. Both full-group fixed subspaces vanish; this is not a claim about integral quotient homotopy.
